propositions: Detached compaction sweep dies between snapshot write/retire and git commit, leaving tracker tree dirty with tracked deletions and untracked snapshot files, blocking subsequent reconverge union merge and stranding commits.

Intent journal + ordered mutation + rollback + startup recovery pattern makes the fold crash-atomic: journal written before any mutation, snapshot-write/rename/commit as single unit, incomplete rollback retains snapshot for fsck repair, recovery discriminates landed vs. abandoned vs. superseded journals and converges to clean tree.
Recovery must distinguish transient git faults (index.lock, timeout) from genuinely absent snapshots to avoid mis-classifying a transient failure as committed and reverting a landed fold.
Interim mitigation `[compact] trigger="off"` in user config must be removable once crash-atomicity fix is merged and verified.
